'''''Star Wars: Poe Dameron''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Charles Soule]] and drawn by [[Phil Noto]] that focuses on the [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]]. Published by [[Marvel Comics]], the series focuses on the events prior to the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], and events before and after the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. It also features the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] and centers around the Resistance's struggle [[Cold War|against]] the [[First Order]]. The series was first announced on [[January 14]], [[2016]] in advance of Marvel's regular April 2016 solicitations. The first issue was published on [[April 6]], 2016, and it concluded with its thirty-first issue in September 26, 2018.
